title: PTSIP RA_list (unresolved, unregistered)
$comment: The root no longer rejects all inputs and does not establish an approved RA field structure. The draft projection is an optional, non-normative structural candidate. Contract activation remains UNREGISTERED and authorization remains prohibited in RA_list_contracts.json. A resolver must reject duplicate input keys and verify owner, declaration, and revision references.

bindings.description: The outer key is the registered owner of the link. The inner key is the stable binding key declared by that owner. Together they identify the RA entry independently of its revision.

revision.description: Exact revision of the owner-declared binding.

responsibility.description: Registered responsibility assigned by the linked RAC.

authority.description: Registered authority evaluated by the linked AEC.

rac.description: Exact revision of the registered RAC condition declaration.

aec.description: Exact revision of the registered AEC condition declaration.
